title: Preparing for pregnancy
what: This is a doctor's visit before pregnancy. The doctor checks your health, orders tests, and advises you on how to prepare.
why: When you plan to get pregnant in the coming months. Especially if you have a long-term illness or had difficult pregnancies before.
duration: the visit usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; test results are usually ready in a few days
tell_doctor: What medicines you take. Do not stop them on your own; the doctor will choose safe ones
How past pregnancies and births went
If any inherited diseases run in your family

prepare.title: Your cycle
prepare.text: Remember the date your last period started.

prepare.title: Documents
prepare.text: Gather past test results and your vaccination record.

prepare.title: Questions
prepare.text: Write down what you want to ask: vitamins, diet, exercise, smoking and alcohol.

bring: Your vaccination record, if you have one
steps: The doctor asks about your health and plans
You have an exam, sometimes a pelvic exam
You get referrals for blood and urine tests and swabs
The doctor recommends vitamins and lifestyle changes
Your partner may also be advised to get checked
feel: A regular visit with nothing unpleasant
The pelvic exam may be a little uncomfortable
after: Do the tests on the list
Come back to the doctor with the results
You are usually advised to start folic acid ahead of time. The doctor will tell you the dose
You may be advised to get vaccines before pregnancy

faq.q: How long before pregnancy should I start preparing?
faq.a: Usually 2 to 3 months before. Your doctor will tell you more exactly.

faq.q: Does my partner need to be checked?
faq.a: Often, yes: a general checkup and tests for infections. Sometimes a semen analysis.

reminders.text: Pregnancy planning visit tomorrow. Bring your list of medicines and past test results.
